title: Core Stack Member 2 Boot Loop — C-212 Failover Incomplete

fields.subject: Core stack member 2 in A-B02 is in a boot loop after a power fault on the stack link. The C-212 core did not take over because its configuration is from February 27 and does not include the clinical VLANs added in change CHG-1184 on March 4.
fields.description: Core stack member 2 in A-B02 is in a boot loop after a power fault on the stack link. The C-212 core did not take over because its configuration is from February 27 and does not include the clinical VLANs added in change CHG-1184 on March 4. I can load the March 10 backup config onto C-212, which would bring the clinical VLANs up but not the PACS and device VLANs, in about 45 minutes. Replacement hardware from the vendor is four hours away.

activity.author: Network Engineer Nadia Petrov
activity.text: Confirmed boot loop on stack member 2 in A-B02. C-212 core has no record of VLAN changes from CHG-1184 (March 4). Configuration mismatch prevents failover. Manual intervention required.

activity.author: Network Operations Team
activity.text: Ticket opened via network monitoring alert from ORRMC-INT01 (10.72.1.11).

activity.author: ServiceDesk
activity.text: Automated routing to Network Operations based on configuration item ORRMC-INT01.

instructorNote: This inject establishes the root cause of the outage: a misconfigured failover core. The IT leader must decide whether to restore partial connectivity now (clinical VLANs only) or wait for full hardware replacement. Watch for whether the DIT consults the ISO before proceeding.
